description: This file declares the IMediaKeysIpcFactory interface, a factory class for creating IMediaKeys instances for IPC in the Rialto media framework. It includes method declarations for creating media keys based on a key system string and a static method for creating the factory itself.

classes.name: IMediaKeysIpcFactory
classes.description: A factory class that provides methods to create IMediaKeys instances for IPC based on a key system string.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaKeysIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: createMediaKeysIpc
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IMediaKeys instance for the specified key system.
